status: 27 Oct 2026 (WAINUT, PR #105; targets/carlos1903/): the unit holds three code telegrams of 1903. Two (12 May, and one undated) were read from decodes of the time filed with them (m0058 and the card m0060) and are written up. This one (m0056, 47 items) has no decode and is not read; the code is not rebuilt. The clear letters run to 1905.
